allow: PowerShell($files = Get-ChildItem generated/saved -File | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending; $keep = $files[0]; "Keeping: $\($keep.Name\) \($\($keep.LastWriteTime\)\)"; $del = $files | Select-Object -Skip 1; $mb = [math]::Round\(\($del | Measure-Object Length -Sum\).Sum / 1MB, 1\); $del | Remove-Item -Force -Confirm:$false; "Deleted $\($del.Count\) files, freed $mb MB"; \(Get-ChildItem generated/saved\).Name)

PowerShell($body = @{ targetLanguage = "roman-hindi"; segments = @\(@{text="Ask only Allah, because He alone is the giver."; start=0; duration=3.2; end=3.2}, @{text="When everyone is asleep, pour your heart out to Him."; start=3.2; duration=4; end=7.2}\) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; try { Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost:3000/api/translate-transcript -Method Post -ContentType "application/json; charset=utf-8" -Body \([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes\($body\)\) -TimeoutSec 90 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 } catch { "ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
